articles.title: Anthropic Revenue Ahead of IPO Surges Over 14-Fold in Second Quarter
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News.
articles.author: Bailey Lipschultz and Rachel Metz

articles.title: Signs of a Slowing US Consumer | Open Interest 8/14/2026
articles.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dave Gura on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Signs the consumer is finally slowing sown. Today, retail sales post their biggest drop in more than a year as confidence slides. Oil rises as Washington threatens more economic pressure on Iran. Plus, OpenAI’s revenue surge ahead of a highly anticipated IPO. And we’ll hear from Flock Safety CEO Garrett Langley and LOVB Pro Commissioner Sandra Idehen on the $20 million boom in women’s volleyball. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: SpaceX Completes Its $60 Billion Cursor Acquisition
articles.summary: SpaceX has completed a $60 billion acquisition of artificial intelligence coding startup Cursor, a key part of Elon Musk’s bid to gain ground on rivals Anthropic PBC and OpenAI.
articles.author: Carmen Arroyo and Natasha Mascarenhas

articles.title: India Less Exposed to AI Job Risks Than Others, Goldman Says
articles.summary: India’s labor force is unlikely to face widespread job losses from artificial intelligence, though some positions in the services sector could be affected, Goldman Sachs Group’s Chief India economist Santanu Sengupta said Friday.
articles.author: Anup Roy

articles.title: Thrive Investor Letter Reveals OpenAI-Fueled Growth, Stake Sale
articles.summary: Thrive Capital’s 2022 early-stage venture capital fund, a $516 million investment vehicle that made early bets on OpenAI, SpaceX and Anduril Industries Inc., has grown to be worth more than $3.7 billion as of the end of June.
articles.author: Natasha Mascarenhas

articles.title: Easing Inflation and AI Rally Push Stocks Toward Records | The Close 8/13/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Wells Fargo CIO, Wealth & Investment Darrell Cronk, JLL President, Retail Advisory Services Naveen Jaggi, Barclays Managing Director, Senior Retail Analyst Adrienne Yih, Bluestone Equity Partners Founder & Managing Partner Bobby Sharma, Janus Henderson Head, Multi-Asset Macro Investing Mike Contopoulos, Susquehanna International Group Senior Equity Research Analyst Mehdi Hosseini, Mizuho Securities Managing Director, Restaurants Equity Research Nick Setyan, JAB Holdings Chief Investment Officer Anant Bhalla, & VMG Partners Managing Partners Robin Tsai. articles.title: Solving integration woes with a hackathon
articles.summary: Ryan welcomes Meryll Blanchet, Director of Engineering for Adobe Brand Visibility, to chat about Adobe’s recent acquisition of Semrush, how Adobe Brand Visibility was born from Semrush’s AI visibility product and Adobe’s LLM Optimizer, and how Adobe used a three-day internal hackathon instead of a large-scale infrastructure integration to quickly deliver value to customers.
articles.author: Phoebe Sajor

articles.title: Morgan Stanley’s Weaver Warns of Risks in AI-Compute Bottleneck
articles.summary: Companies are seeing increasingly meaningful artificial intelligence adoption, but constraints on computing supply remain a bottleneck for growth, according to Morgan Stanley’s Michelle Weaver.
articles.author: Paayal Zaveri and Ed Ludlow

articles.title: Why Open-Weight AI Models Won’t Kill the Closed Model
articles.summary: AI demand continues to outstrip available computing capacity, and Morgan Stanley sees little risk of oversupply anytime soon. US thematic research strategist Michelle Weaver joins Bloomberg to discuss growing evidence of returns from corporate AI adoption, why labor and power remain critical constraints on the data center buildout, and why she expects companies to ultimately use a mix of open and closed AI models. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Mark Bezos’ Fund Faces Fight to Recoup Losses From Fence Startup
articles.summary: A venture capital firm co-founded by Jeff Bezos’ younger brother Mark sank $11.7 million into a startup that fashioned itself as an Uber of fence installation. Now it’s suing the startup’s founder after the company’s collapse amid allegations of fraud and mismanagement.
articles.author: Sabrina Willmer

articles.title: Nvidia-Backed Startup CodeRabbit Valued at $1.5 Billion in Round
articles.summary: CodeRabbit Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered code review service, has raised $143 million in a new funding round, tapping into demand for tools to spot flaws in AI-generated software programming.
articles.author: Lorelei Smillie

articles.title: Whoop Plans to Double Size of Boston Headquarters Ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Whoop Inc., the maker of popular screenless fitness trackers, plans to roughly double the size of its Boston headquarters, boosting a city struggling to grab a bigger piece of the artificial intelligence boom.
articles.author: Greg Ryan
